host_tests.ASan_UBSan_picocalc: PASS: core, keyboard, UI, settings journal, FAT, BASIC/FOCAL, M61/Turochamp, RTC/alarms, sleep timestamp regression, USB Screen protocol

architecture.chip8: shared code/chip8.cpp, 700 Hz instructions / 60 Hz timers; physical/remote held/release
architecture.usb_screen: shared COBS/CRC16/PackBits protocol v2, atomic 192x64 frames, MINI virtual keyboard, 3 s heartbeat
architecture.native_app: ABI 6, ARMv6-M flag 8, soft-float, 48 KiB per APP, CRC/ZX0/BCJ/relocation, common public C services
architecture.stm32_app: default Cortex-M4/hard-float and 20 KiB limit preserved; cross-CPU APP rejected before entry
architecture.rtc: RP2040 hardware RTC; watchdog scratch snapshot for software reset; FAT timestamps; alarms A/B and M61 date/alarm
architecture.sleep: LCD+keyboard backlights off, panel sleep, calculator paused, CPU waits between I2C polls; RTC/USB/alarm wake maintained
architecture.timestamp_fix: Fresh monotonic time after a blocking interpreter; sleep due rejects an older time than last activity

limits: RTC loses continuity after complete power loss; no separate RTC battery on Pico H.
Polling sleep is implemented; dormant current is not claimed.
Native M4 APP require rebuilding for Pico H; system services are resident in this profile.
